subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom.

These things are very __hard to swallow.__
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"hard to swallow"** means something that is difficult to accept or believe. (मानने में कठिन)

 
 
• **Example: **His explanation for being late was **hard to swallow.**
 
 
 
• **"difficult to believe"** refers to something that is not easily accepted as true or real. (विश्वास करना कठिन)
 
 
• **Example: **The news of his sudden departure was difficult to believe.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **difficult to believe**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **difficult to resist** (प्रतिरोध करना कठिन): Something that is hard to refuse or avoid.

 
 
• **Example:** The temptation to eat chocolate is difficult to resist.
 
 
 
• **difficult to speak** (बोलना कठिन): Something that is hard to articulate or say.
 
 
• **Example:** After the accident, it was difficult for him to speak.
 
 
 
• **difficult to eat** (खाना कठिन): Something that is hard to chew or consume.
 
 
• **Example:** The steak was so tough that it was difficult to eat.
 
 

 

203:Tc81,

The correct answer is **Option 2)**
